name: ColorSwatchPicker
tagline: The Colour Swatch Picker replaces a plain text box that holds a colour code with a friendly colour chooser.
description: The Colour Swatch Picker replaces a plain text box that holds a colour code with a friendly colour chooser. You click a swatch from your organisation's palette, or - if your app maker allows it - type a colour code or open your device's colour picker. The chosen colour is shown in a preview bar together with its name and code, and a small check tells you whether black or white text is easier to read on it.
features: Compact square swatches saved as rgb()
